claim: The Bangs Laboratories Flash Red dye, used in FSFR004 and FSFR005, has its emission maximum at 690 nm as published by the supplier.

identifiers.catalogue_product: FSFR001-FSFR007 (the Flash Red plain polystyrene line)

validity_conditions: Read from the heading of the supplier's Flash Red spectrum image, 'Flash Red (660, 690)', whose trace shows both bands peaking between about 650 and 700 nm with little signal below 600 nm. A peak is not a band: the widths are shown only as a curve and are not entered. Diameter-independent in the supplier's presentation. The spectrum's medium (in beads, in water, or free dye) is not stated on the page. Entered separately from the other peak so each can be refuted on its own. Type-level fact about the catalogue product as sold. It says nothing about a bottle on this bench until a person reads the catalogue number and lot off it; no such reading is on record yet.
